title: Universal property of the explicit sheafified orbit quotient
statement: Let $S,G,G^{\prime},\varphi,T,P,Q,q$ be as in [lem-sc-etale-contracted-product-exists-data]. For every sheaf of sets $F$ and every family $a_U:T(U)\times G^{\prime}(U)\to F(U)$ which respects restrictions and satisfies $a_U(g+t,h-\varphi(g))=a_U(t,h)$, there is a unique sheaf morphism $l:Q\to F$ with $l_U(q_U(t,h))=a_U(t,h)$ for all $U,t,h$.

source.place: Tag 03AJ, label lemma-torsors-h1, fibre-of-a-section construction; contracted-product construction from lem-sc-etale-torsor-pushout-extension step 2; torsors as in Tag 03AH

proof.text: Quot.lift descends a to P because invariance identifies each generating relation. Quotient induction reduces the naturality equation to the supplied naturality of a.

Apply sheafifyLift to the descended presheaf morphism. The sheafification unit equation gives its values on q. If another sheaf morphism has these values, quotient induction makes its composite with the unit equal to the constructed composite. sheafify_hom_ext proves uniqueness.

proof_origin.note: Formalized from the original contracted-product plan; explicit quotient, local coordinates and sheafification factorization compiled.
